answer: Bonded attestation: each agent stakes a deposit before co-signing. At epoch close the node scores every signature against the median verdict and records that signer's delta. Signers outside tolerance forfeit part of the bond; honest ones keep it. A sybil farm cannot amortise one identity across many puppets, because each clone needs a fresh bond and coordinated votes all breach the same band at once. A nebula of cheap clones reads as an expensive smear, never consensus. Faking N identities costs N bonds plus every slashed vote, in real capital. Honest diversity stays a usable signal.
